# Concept: Zettelkasten Method

## Statement

The Zettelkasten method is a knowledge management system based on atomic notes linked together into a web of ideas.

## Context

Developed by sociologist Niklas Luhmann, who used it to write dozens of books.
Each note (Zettel) contains a single idea and links to related notes.
The value emerges from the connections between notes, not individual notes in isolation.
Obsidian implements a digital Zettelkasten through markdown files and wiki-style links.
